user_question: Create a choropleth map of hospital counts across Centre County.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Create a choropleth map of hospital counts across Centre County.

workflow_steps.title: Join tract and subdivision attributes
workflow_steps.purpose: Prepare the tract polygons with subdivision attributes while retaining tract geometry for downstream hospital counting.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a spatial join using input_2 as the target tract layer and input_3 as the subdivision layer. Retain the tract polygon geometry and associated tract attributes, adding matching subdivision attributes.

workflow_steps.title: Count hospitals by tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate the number of hospital point features within each Centre County tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Count the hospital points from input_1 within the polygons in enriched_tracts. Preserve the polygon attributes and write the count to a new field named hospital_count.

workflow_steps.title: Create hospital-count choropleth map
workflow_steps.purpose: Produce an interactive HTML choropleth map showing hospital counts by tract.
workflow_steps.instructions: Generate an interactive choropleth map from hospital_count_polygons, classifying and visualizing the hospital_count field.

agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic vector joins, dissolves, grouped aggregations, attribute joins, and buffering. Vector operations consume GeoPackage inputs. The service does not convert formats, repair invalid geometries, or reproject inputs automatically.
